summary: Anju Jayraj (Head, Office of Outreach) presented Ashoka University's NEP-aligned 4-year liberal-arts curriculum, its two-track assessment (Ashoka Aptitude Assessment or Ashoka Mathematics Challenge, plus a mandatory 30-minute on-spot essay), and its financial-aid model. She stated that roughly 43-44% of the current class is on financial aid against an institutional goal of 50%, and gave placement figures of a Rs 42.5 LPA highest package against a Rs 13.5 LPA average, drawn from 260+ recruiting companies on campus.
keyInsights: Admissions: Ashoka Aptitude Assessment or Ashoka Mathematics Challenge, plus a mandatory 30-minute on-spot essay -- no application fee at any stage.
~43-44% of the current student body is on financial aid; the institutional goal is 50%.
260+ companies recruit on campus; placement range runs from Rs 13.5 LPA average to Rs 42.5 LPA highest package.
